Stevens pays $3,000–$5,000 for a brand identity project. Sidekicks pays $1,500–$3,000. Both fixed-price, worldwide remote.
Monthly retainers exist too: Love Isn't Blind pays $1,000–$2,000/mo, South Digital $2,000–$4,000/mo.
64% of listings are open worldwide. But 78% hide pay. Focus on the 22% that publish rates.
Higher fixed price isn't always better. A $1,500–$3,000 retainer can mean steadier cash flow than a $5,000 sprint.
